meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 就能通过 Slack 收发消息。它会复制 Slack 适配器、注册到核心、安装固定版本的依赖,并引导你创建 Slack 应用、填写令牌,最后重启服务使配置生效。
howto.when: 当你在设置流程中要求添加 Slack 频道,或使用 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 等命令配置频道时触发。

say.text: 添加 Slack 频道,用 Socket Mode 连接
say.note: 会引导你创建 Slack 应用并填写令牌。

say.text: 把 Slack 接入用 Webhook 方式
say.note: 需要提供公网 HTTPS 地址。

say.text: 设置好 Slack 后重启服务
say.note: 重启后加载适配器和配置。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw gains the ability to send and receive messages over Slack. It copies the Slack adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, guides you through creating a Slack app and entering tokens, then restarts the service to apply the config.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Slack channel during setup, or use commands like /init-first-agent or /manage-channels to configure channels.

say_en.text: Add a Slack channel using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Walks you through creating a Slack app and entering tokens.

say_en.text: Set up Slack via webhook delivery.
Restart the service after Slack setup.
